baseline_evidence: PR #324 / run 35880062788 qualified the time-aware Gummel architecture.
Gen13 run 35978463311 directly identified a full-rank 20x20 electron-potential response matrix.
Gen14 run 35981452978 showed a scalar local-Laplacian projection is not sufficient: nearest-neighbor fit ran away and full projection completed with higher FP cost than control.

objective.architecture_invariant: retain the Gummel electron/energy <-> Poisson fixed-point architecture
objective.metric: average fixed-point loops per electron step
objective.success_condition: stable four-step FP reduction with qualified trajectory/profile parity; O(10) remains the promotion target

frozen_invariants: plasma equations and BC ownership at the converged fixed point
thermal charged-heavy wall plus sheath-suppressed electron wall model
nonlinear and fixed-point convergence tolerances/stopping criteria

hypotheses.statement: The dominant Gummel response requires a finite-width nonlocal electron-potential Jacobian rather than a diagonal reaction or scalar Laplacian surrogate; retaining measured off-diagonal structure over a sufficiently wide band will improve contraction while preserving the uniform-potential near-null mode.
hypotheses.mechanism: Use the Gen13 basis response normalized row-wise by n_e/VTe. Retain measured off-diagonal entries within half-bandwidth 1, 3 or 5, reset each diagonal to the negative retained off-diagonal row sum, and scale each row by the current n_e/VTe. Apply the resulting matrix to phi-phi_anchor inside the Poisson iteration operator.
hypotheses.falsifier: Reject the tested banded approximation if all widths fail to reduce fixed-point work versus the same-lane control, become unstable, or violate same-time physical parity. Separately flag anchor/update semantics if returned phi_anchor does not match the preceding potential iterate.
prior_evidence: The direct Gen13 Jacobian has positive diagonal and negative nonlocal off-diagonal entries with near-zero row sums.
The row-sum-preserving band-1, band-3 and band-5 projections have reference relative Frobenius errors about 0.698, 0.333 and 0.157 respectively.
Gen14 demonstrated that collapsing the measured matrix to a scalar Laplacian does not preserve enough operator structure.

discriminating_observables: residual stability over four electron steps
potential trajectory and final profile parity
band projection error versus the Gen13 full response
phi_anchor versus preceding phi_current at every recorded fixed-point iteration
controls: same-lane unmodified qualified time-aware Picard-2x control
one heavy cycle / four electron steps / T=400 tau_epsilon(initial)
identical physics, timestep, wall model, nonlinear tolerance and fixed-point stopping criteria
every trial row is explicitly zero-sum and correction vanishes when phi equals phi_anchor

variants.change: retain measured off-diagonal response for |i-j|<=1 and reconstruct diagonal from zero row sum
retain measured off-diagonal response for |i-j|<=3 and reconstruct diagonal from zero row sum
retain measured off-diagonal response for |i-j|<=5 and reconstruct diagonal from zero row sum
